**Use this template for concrete, verifiable errors** — a broken `§` cross-reference, a schema in `LUNEX-Specification.md` that doesn't match Appendix A, a typo, a number that doesn't add up (this project has found several of exactly that kind before — see `docs/PROJECT-RECORD.md`, Phase 8). For "I think this design is wrong," use [Discussions](../../discussions) instead — that's a design conversation, not a correction.
